* Good understanding of treasury operations, payment workflows, banking integrations, and financial messaging standards.
* Familiarity with SWIFT, ERP integration, payment files, bank statements, and treasury system interfaces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Computer Science, or a related discipline.


**Experience**

* Experience supporting at least two end\-to\-end SAP TRM, treasury system, payment hub, or treasury transformation implementations is preferred.

* Exposure to SQL scripting, automation tools, and reporting scripts.
* Familiarity with Citrix environments and job scheduling tools.

**Technical Expertise**
 The candidate should have hands\-on or working knowledge across SAP TRM and Treasury Management Systems, with exposure to the following functional areas:
   

  

* Foreign Exchange (FX): trade capture, settlement, and valuation support.
* Interest Rate Swaps: configuration and lifecycle support.

**Senior Associate, Accounting Transformation** 




**Role Summary** 




 The Accounting Transformation team partners with clients to improve, remediate, and modernize their accounting operations. As a Senior Associate, you will assess accounting processes, financial data, and reporting practices to identify risks, compliance gaps, and operational inefficiencies. You will lead accounting remediation initiatives, including financial statement clean\-up, account reconciliations, GAAP adjustments, close process documentation, and implementation of scalable accounting practices.
 



 This is a project\-based individual contributor role focused on transforming accounting functions and delivering sustainable outcomes. Success is measured by the quality, accuracy, and completeness of the accounting records, reconciliations, and close processes you leave behind.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Accounting Assessment \& Analysis** 



* Evaluate accounting policies, procedures, controls, and reporting practices for compliance with US GAAP.
* Review transaction cycles, including revenue, procure\-to\-pay, payroll, and month\-end close processes.
* Identify accounting risks, reporting issues, control gaps, and operational inefficiencies.
* Assess the quality of the general ledger, chart of accounts, and underlying financial data.
* Document findings and develop remediation plans to address identified issues.



**Accounting Remediation \& Transformation** 



* Perform accounting clean\-up initiatives, including historical corrections, opening balance sheet reconstruction, and cash\-to\-accrual conversions.
* Prepare and post adjusting journal entries supported by appropriate calculations and documentation.
* Apply US GAAP guidance across key accounting areas, including revenue recognition, deferred revenue, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, leases, and equity.
* Rebuild or optimize chart of accounts structures and support financial data remediation efforts.
* Research accounting issues and prepare supporting analysis and documentation.



**Reconciliations \& Close Process Development** 



* Perform balance sheet reconciliations and resolve outstanding reconciling items.
* Develop and document month\-end close procedures, workflows, and control activities.
* Create workpapers, reconciliation templates, supporting schedules, and audit\-ready documentation.
* Establish repeatable and scalable close processes that can be maintained by ongoing accounting teams.
* Transition completed engagements to Exbo's Controllership team through comprehensive documentation and knowledge transfer.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* CPA, CA, CMA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* 3 \+ years of accounting experience in public accounting, controllership, accounting operations, or financial reporting.
* Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting research methodologies.
* Experience managing full\-cycle month\-end close activities and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Hands\-on experience preparing and posting adjusting journal entries.
* Advanced Excel skills, including large data analysis, pivot tables, lookup functions, and Power Query.
* Strong written communication skills with the ability to create clear process documentation.
* High attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to producing accurate, audit\-ready work.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects with limited supervision.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience assessing and redesigning accounting processes and controls.
* Hands\-on experience with QuickBooks Online.
* Experience with accounting clean\-ups, first\-audit readiness projects, or finance transformation initiatives.
* Experience supporting US\-based clients and working within US GAAP reporting environments.
* Experience with venture\-backed, private equity\-backed, or high\-growth companies.



**Success in This Role** 



* Deliver accurate, reconciled, and GAAP\-compliant financial records.
* Create sustainable accounting processes and audit\-ready documentation.
* Independently manage engagements from assessment through transition.
* Enable ongoing accounting teams to execute a repeatable and well\-documented close process with confidence.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Company Description** 
 Mind \& Matter India is an integrated digital solutions company with a global presence across Asia and Europe, operating from offices in Kolkata, Bangalore, and Birmingham (UK). The organization connects four key business areas: digital media and marketing, edTech, IT\-enabled services, mobile app and web app development. Over the past 20 years, the company has grown through future\-focused thinking, strategic execution, and wise investment in technology and talent. Mind \& Matter showcases all its businesses under one umbrella brand, emphasizing global capabilities, local focus, and a unified culture. Applicants can explore individual business lines via their LinkedIn company pages to understand the breadth of services and opportunities.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a Business Analyst (Customer Solution \& Requirements), you will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams. You will lead customer discovery sessions to uncover operational challenges, translate business needs into detailed functional specifications, and ensure delivered software solutions align directly with customer goals while minimizing scope creep and rework.
 



  





**Role Outcomes** 



* Client onboarding transitions smoothly from signed contract into discovery, scope baselines, and implementation roadmaps.
* Drive and ownership of Client business goals being accurately translated into structured BRDs, FRDs, and SRS documents that drive the end\-to\-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Engineering, UI/UX, and QA teams receive production\-ready user stories, system workflows, business logic, and acceptance criteria across all development sprints.
* Scope creep and requirement churn are proactively controlled through formal change management and continuous client communication.
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT) achieves fast, structured sign\-offs with direct traceability to the agreed functional specifications.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Discovery \& Client Stakeholder Management** 



* Lead post\-sales requirement workshops, discovery, kickoff sessions, and recurring discovery meetings with client\-side product owners, department heads, and end users.
* Uncover operational challenges, target workflows, and critical success factors; translate contractual scope into realistic functional deliverables.
* Capture detailed meeting minutes, decisions, system dependencies, assumptions, and risk items, obtaining formal client sign\-off.
* Serve as the primary post\-sales functional liaison between the client and internal technical delivery teams.



**Requirement Engineering (BRD, FRD, SRS \& Process Modeling)** 



* Create end\-to\-end
 **Business Requirements Documents (BRD)** 
 detailing business objectives, high\-level scope, user roles, and operational constraints.
* Formulate exhaustive
 **Functional Requirements Documents (FRD)** 
 specifying UI behavior, validations, error handling, system logic, and data structures.
* Develop and maintain
 **Software Requirements Specifications (SRS)** 
 inputs, covering non\-functional requirements, external interfaces, and system interaction constraints.
* Map current client operations (As\-Is) to proposed platform capabilities (To\-Be) using diagrams, process models, and data flow diagrams.
* Maintain a live
 **Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM)** 
 linking each business objective through FRD/SRS specifications, sprint backlog items, test cases, and deployment.



**Sprint Execution \& Software Life Cycle (SDLC) Enablement** 



* Own functional grooming throughout the Agile/Scrum delivery lifecycle, breaking down FRDs and SRS items into well\-structured user stories with clear Given\-When\-Then acceptance criteria.
* Drive the Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, and Sprint Reviews to ensure engineering and QA teams understand functional nuances before development begins.
* Provide continuous, in\-sprint functional support to resolve blockers, clarify ambiguous edge cases, and validate work\-in\-progress features.
* Enforce change request procedures by evaluating the scope, cost, sprint velocity, and schedule impact of new client feature requests.



**User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Go\-Live \& Handover** 



* Formulate UAT plans, test scenarios, and acceptance checklists aligned with the signed FRD/SRS.
* Coordinate UAT execution directly with client business users, triaging reported defects to distinguish genuine functional bugs from new out\-of\-scope change requests.
* Guide clients through release demos, product walkthroughs, and end\-user enablement sessions to secure formal project sign\-off.
* Support post\-launch rollout, deployment and functional knowledge transfer to the ongoing client support team.



  





**Expected Deliverables** 



* Client Discovery Agenda, Stakeholder Map, and Meeting Action Logs
* As\-Is \& To\-Be Process Flowcharts and Data Flow Diagrams
* Business Requirements Document (BRD)
* Functional Requirements Document (FRD)
* Software Requirements Specification (SRS) inputs
* Sprint\-Ready User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Edge\-Case Matrices
* Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM)
* Change Request Logs with Scope and Timeline Impact Assessments
* UAT Test Scripts, Defect Logs, and Client Acceptance Sign\-Off Records



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or Engineering.
* **1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, or Solution Analyst in a post\-sales, software solution development or SaaS implementation environment.**
* Hands\-on experience drafting formal
 **BRD, FRD, and SRS** 
 documentation, as well as managing sprint backlogs in Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Solid understanding of the complete
 **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)** 
 and Agile/Scrum execution practices.
* Proven track record of independently facilitating workshops and managing client expectations across multiple post\-sales engagements.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and stakeholder presentation skills.
